claim_boundary: Exact integer verification of a single finite Hadamard witness: H @ H.T == n * I over the integers. This certifies the existence of one matrix of that order. It is not a proof of the Hadamard conjecture, says nothing about equivalence classes, and makes no claim about orders for which no witness was verified.

verification.claim_boundary: Exact integer verification of a single finite Hadamard witness: H @ H.T == n * I over the integers. This certifies the existence of one matrix of that order. It is not a proof of the Hadamard conjecture, says nothing about equivalence classes, and makes no claim about orders for which no witness was verified.
